snippet.title: Blocks for Babies Trailer | TGAGWCAGA 2024
snippet.description:
Blocks for Babies is a block-stacking boomer shooter where every kill shapes the game board. Arrange falling tiles into complete lines, or go in guns blazing to clean up the board the messy way. Hard and soft drops aren't your only tools anymore—now you have a shotgun.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2776770/Blocks_for_Babies/

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/jev6BHgMx4

Trailer originally debuted at The Game Award for Game Who Can't Afford The Game Awards (TGAGWCAGA)
